title: Deliver Us From Eva
description: In order to get a breather from their meddling sister-in-law (Gabrielle Union), three men pay a playboy (LL Cool J) $5,000 to romance her.

title: Glory
description: Col. Robert Gould Shaw (Matthew Broderick) trains and leads an all-black regiment during the U.S. Civil War.

title: Miles Ahead
description: In the 1970s, down-and-out jazz trumpeter Miles Davis (Don Cheadle) tries to recover his new session tape from music producers.

title: Favorite Son
description: Twin brothers in a gospel group struggle to find balance of life, love, faith, and religion while under the strict rule of their father, who is the reverend of a megachurch.

title: Favorite Son Christmas
description: First Lady Rita proposes a holiday reunion of her sons' gospel group SO G.I.F.T.E.D. to put a damaging scandal behind them and pull Graceway Church out of financial trouble.

title: The Pursuit of Happyness
description: A struggling salesman takes custody of his son as he's poised to begin a life-changing professional career.

title: A Christmas Gift
description: In a failed attempt to cancel Christmas, the McKenzies find themselves navigating a season filled with unexpected guests, secrets and revelations that will have a lasting effect on their lives.

title: A Rich Christmas
description: A spoiled and ungrateful socialite learns a valuable lesson one Christmas after her wealthy father forces her to work at the first property he ever owned -- a family homeless center.

title: Christmas Déjà Vu
description: An angel grants a wish to a woman who wants to be a singer but hates Christmas.
